lessons.title: 1. Modern C++ STL Algorithms
lessons.description: Modern C++ checkpoint: implement sortVector(std::vector<int>& vec) so it sorts the vector in place with std::sort over the [vec.begin(), vec.end()) iterator range. The test sorts {3, 1, 2} and checks the result.

tests.name: test_sort_vec

source.name: cppreference.com — std::sort — 'Sorts the elements in the target range [first, last)'

learning_objectives: Sort a std::vector in place with std::sort
Pass iterator ranges [first, last) to STL algorithms
Include <algorithm> for std::sort and <vector> for the container

exercises.question: A file calls `std::sort` on a `std::vector<int>`. Which headers must it include? Select all that apply.
exercises.explanation: `std::sort` is declared in <algorithm> and the container itself needs <vector>; the other two are unrelated.
